lines.t: Eyes flame, see the wire, see the ledgers, see the stain
Seven hills ’bout to crumble, YAHUWAH bringing flame
All that gold, all that purple, all that power in His sight
When the Lion leaves the throne, Babylon done in a night
War drums, 808s, make the kings shake, fall
Every hidden little deal on the books, He saw
You can ride on the beast, you can drink that blood
But when Heaven pulls up, you gon’ drown in that flood
I seen priests with the wolves in the back room, laugh
While they bless with the right hand, left hand move cash
Offshore, black robes, long chain, no cross
Just a logo and a pass where the laws get tossed
City built on the hills with a chalice and a crown
Said they speak for the Lamb but they hunt saints down
Trails of the orphan’s tears in the marble hall
Yeah, the files got leaked but He knew it all
Flights to the island, names in the night
Little ones cry but they hid that fright
Private jets to the “Holy” see, what a joke
You can’t hide smoke when the altar’s broke
Committees, commissions, “reform” that bank
Just a new paint job on a rotting plank
From the cleric to the king to the tech‑board seat
They all share wine from the harlot’s seat
I ain’t scared of no pope, no prince, no cell
I’m more scared of the One who can cast into hell
You can sign with the dragon, kiss that ring
But my King crack sky, let the judgment ring

All that gold, all that purple, all that power in His sight

War drums, 808s, make the kings shake, fall
Every hidden little deal on the books, He saw
You can ride on the beast, you can drink that blood
But when Heaven pulls up, you gon’ drown in that flood
I hear whispers in the dark, “One church, one throne”
But the Bride ain’t mixed with that whore you own
They traded His Name for a brand and a show
Turned the cross to a staff for the empire’s glow
Secret councils in the back, plotting world‑wide law
Got a lamb on the banner but a serpent’s claw
Ink on the treaty, beast in the pen
Ten horns waiting just to burn that den
YahuShua watch every private chat log, scheme
Every coded little phrase in the think‑tank dream
They say “peace, peace” while they load that clip
But the plagues in His hand ’bout to start that trip
No halo for the men who sold kids for a fee
No mercy for the clerks of the old IOR tree
You laundered that pain through a holy name
Now the fire you built gon’ return as flame
Let the trumpets blow in the trap tonight
Let the angels march when the bass ignite
If you riding with the Lamb, better stand up, fight
If you married to the whore, better run from the light

All that gold, all that purple, all that power in His sight
When the Lion leaves the throne, Babylon done in a night
War drums, 808s, make the kings shake, fall
Every hidden little deal on the books, He saw
You can ride on the beast, you can drink that blood
But when Heaven pulls up, you gon’ drown in that flood
From the files in the vault to the dirt in the field
To the prophet on the corner with the sword and the shield
The report been sent, the decree been sealed
Every fake high priest ’bout to get revealed
You built towers off the backs of the poor, that’s theft
You crowned yourself queen, said no sorrow left
But the smoke from your seat gonna block that sun
When the cup you poured out get back, one‑for‑one
YAHUWAH don’t sleep, He just waits, then strikes
Heard every little “oops” on them private flights
Every laugh in the dark when the tape got burned
Heaven got backup, every lie’s been turned
So I stand in the booth with a two‑edged flow
Let the hi‑hats cut where the sermons won’t go
If you love that Lamb, better break those ties
Come out from the system or die in her lies
Yeah
Seven hills in the scope, one shot, one fall
YahuShua on the clouds, that’s the end of it all
No more kings, no more whore, no more fraud in the wall
Only YAHUWAH high, every knee to the floor, that’s all
